full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white fashion photograph of a woman in a broad translucent hat turning her face up toward the left. The background is a softly mottled studio wall in middle gray, with no distinct horizon or furniture. She occupies almost the entire frame from her upper arms to the wide brim, leaving small irregular spaces of gray around her. Her dark hair is gathered at the back, and the low crown of the hat sits above it. A fine open mesh spreads across the very wide brim, most visible on the left where light passes through it; the darker brim crosses her brow and extends almost to the right edge. Her face is in three-quarter profile, nose and lips projecting into the side light, eyes lowered or hidden beneath the brim. Bright light catches the left side of her forehead, cheek, neck, and bare upper arm. The opposite side falls rapidly into deep shadow, making the line of the jaw and long neck more prominent. She wears a dark, textured, short-sleeved garment with a deep V opening at the chest. Her arms angle outward and downward, with one elbow bent at the lower left and the other partly lost against the right edge. The fabric has a faint rough pattern, but its mass reads almost black against the lit skin. The photograph balances soft gray grain with sharp tonal separation: delicate netting remains translucent, while hair and clothing form connected dark shapes. Directional studio light models the face and shoulders, and the background stays diffuse and unobtrusive. The overall composition is sculptural and close, its upward diagonal carried by her raised chin and sweeping hat brim.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一张方形黑白时装摄影：一位戴宽大透纱帽的女子把脸抬向左侧光处。背景是柔和斑驳的中灰色影棚墙，没有明确地平线或家具。她从上臂到宽帽檐几乎占满画幅，周围仅留下不规则的小片灰色空间。深色头发在脑后收拢，帽子的低矮帽冠置于其上。细密而疏透的网纱铺满极宽的帽檐，在光线穿过的左侧最明显；较暗的帽檐掠过眉部，几乎延伸到右画边。面孔呈四分之三侧影，鼻与唇伸入侧光，眼睛垂下或藏在帽檐阴影下。亮光落在前额左侧、脸颊、颈部和裸露的上臂。另一侧迅速坠入深影，使下颌线与修长脖颈更加突出。她穿一件深色、有纹理的短袖衣服，胸前开一道深V形口。双臂向外下方斜伸，左下方一只手肘弯起，另一侧部分没入右画边。衣料有隐约粗纹，但整块在亮肤前读作近黑色。照片让柔和灰颗粒与清晰的明暗分隔相平衡：纤细网纱仍透光，头发和衣服则连成暗色形体。定向影棚光塑造面孔与肩部，背景保持漫散而不抢眼。整体构图贴近且具有雕塑感，抬起的下巴和横扫的帽檐承载向上的斜线。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white studio photography uses a close crop, strong directional side light, and deep connected shadow masses. Bright silvery areas on smooth surfaces meet nearly black textured areas with abrupt but carefully graded transitions. A fine translucent mesh catches light as a delicate stippled layer, while its far edge becomes a clean sweeping contour. Soft mottled gray behind the focal form preserves separation without introducing a distinct setting. The largest dark areas anchor the bottom and one side; a lifted diagonal creates tension against the broad horizontal spread. Grain is visible in the midtones, and small tonal steps remain inside the shadows. The result feels sculptural and intimate, with clarity concentrated on the lit contours and airy material.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白影棚摄影采用近距离裁幅、强烈定向侧光与相连的深影色块。光滑表面的银亮区域与近黑的粗纹区域相接，过渡突然却经过细致明暗分级。细密透光网层以轻巧点状质感承接亮光，其远端边缘则成为清晰的横扫曲线。焦点形体后方的柔和斑驳灰色保持分隔，又不引入明确场景。最大的暗区压住下部与一侧，一道抬升的斜线与宽阔横向伸展形成张力。中间调可见颗粒，阴影内部仍有小幅调子差异。整体效果贴近且有雕塑感，清晰度集中在受光轮廓与轻盈材料上。
theme_en: A woman in a broad translucent hat turns toward the light
theme_zh: 一位戴宽大透纱帽的女子转向光处
name: Fernand Fonssagrives
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
